messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-2.3.8 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Changes in R-3.0.2 were crashing rpy2, and rpy2-2.3.8 is fixing this.
It is available on pypi (`pip install rpy2 --upgrade` should get you 
set), and the short changelog available at the usual place:
http://rpy.sourceforge.net/rpy2/doc-2.3/html/changes.html#release-2-3-8

The fix is also present in the branch `version_2.4.x`.

Laurent
